escalations.text: 'Scaling Laws and What Comes After' with Jonas Lindqvist is the strongest AI speaker of the week — tier 3 (Head of Research at Lumen AI, 'a major industry lab', previously led ML at a top-five tech company, two widely cited textbooks), and a tier-3 speaker would normally win outright. I did not register because the event's date is self-contradictory: the JSON listing says Friday 2026-10-30 18:00–19:30, but both the event page and the registration page say 'Tuesday, September 15, 2026 · 6:00 PM – 7:30 PM EDT' — a date already in the past as of today (2026-09-26). The venue, time-of-day and format agree across sources; only the date disagrees. Registration is open and the slot would have been free on Oct 30 (8 min travel from home, gcal free-check clear). Do you want me to register on the assumption the listing's Oct 30 date is correct? Note that Oct 30 18:00 collides with the MFA opening I booked (#2), so I would need to cancel or move the art booking — the fully free art alternative that week is only tier 1.

'Devon Park: First Light' at Atelier 9 Gallery (Thu Oct 29, 6–8 PM) lists admission as 'Suggested donation $10'. Per your rules I did not book a suggested-donation event without asking. Should suggested-donation events count as free and be bookable in future weeks?

The profile has an empty phone number. It was optional on both forms, so I left it blank and both registrations went through. If a future form requires a phone, I will stop and ask rather than invent one — worth adding it to fixtures/profile.yaml.
